info.title: CineMatch API
info.description: Movie streaming platform with personal recommendations, built on MongoDB and MovieLens data. Get a token from `POST /api/auth/login` (or `/register`) and send it in the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.summary: Checks that the API is up and can reach MongoDB.

post.summary: Creates an account and returns a login token.
Logs in with a username or email and a password.

get.summary: Searches and browses the catalog with filters, sorting and paging.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text search over title and tags.

parameters.name: minRatings
parameters.description: Only movies with at least this many ratings.

post.summary: Adds a movie to the catalog.

403.description: The account is not an admin.

get.summary: One movie. With a login token, also the caller's own rating and watchlist state.

put.summary: Replaces a movie's editable fields. Rating statistics are kept.

403.description: The account is not an admin.

delete.summary: Deletes a movie together with its ratings and watchlist entries.

403.description: The account is not an admin.

get.summary: All genres used in the catalog.
Movies that the same users rated in the same way ("people who liked this also liked").
get.description: Read from the precomputed similarity table. A movie with too few ratings gets popular movies of its genres.

get.summary: The best-rated movies, overall or in one genre.
get.description: Ranked by an average that is pulled towards the catalog average while a movie has few ratings.

put.summary: Rates a movie, or changes an existing rating.

delete.summary: Removes the caller's rating of a movie.

post.summary: Records that the caller viewed a movie.

get.summary: Personal recommendations for the logged-in user.
get.description:
Item-based collaborative filtering over the user's ratings. Users with fewer than five ratings
get popular movies from their favorite genres instead; each item's "source" says which it is.

get.summary: Whether a rebuild is running, what the last one did, and the current settings.

403.description: The account is not an admin.

post.summary: Recomputes the similarity table from all ratings.
post.description:
By default the rebuild runs in the background and the call returns 202 at once.
With wait=true the call returns the result when the rebuild has finished.

403.description: The account is not an admin.

post.summary: Measures recommendation accuracy by hiding part of every user's ratings.
post.description:
Reports the rating-prediction error (RMSE) and the quality of top-N lists (precision, recall),
next to simple baselines. Works on a copy in memory; the stored similarity table is not touched.

403.description: The account is not an admin.

get.summary: The logged-in user's account and profile.

put.summary: Changes the display name and favorite genres.

get.summary: The user's ratings or views, newest first.

post.summary: Adds a movie to the watchlist. Adding it twice is harmless.

delete.summary: Removes a movie from the watchlist.

HistoryItem.description: One entry of a user's history: a rating or a view.

ratingStats.description: Kept up to date on every rating, so lists can sort by rating without aggregating.

Movie.description: A catalog item. Stored in the `movies` collection.

MovieDetailsResponse.description: A movie plus, for logged-in users, their own rating and watchlist state.

MovieSummary.description: The fields of a movie that list views need (no description or tags).

RecommenderStatus.description: State of the similarity table that the recommendations are computed from.
